probes.description: pids.current reads a large, non-trivial count while the fork-bomb-shaped loop runs unfrozen
probes.expectation: pids.current > 20 (confirms the churn workload is real, not a no-op)

probes.description: unshare(CLONE_NEWPID) attempted from the adversarial target under its DEFAULT (no added capabilities) pod spec, before any freeze
probes.expectation: non-zero exit, 'Operation not permitted' — CAP_SYS_ADMIN is required and an ordinary agent workload does not have it
probes.evidence:
status=1 out=unshare: unshare(0x20020000): Operation not permitted
command terminated with exit code 1
probes.note: a capability boundary, not a Landlock/cgroup one — recorded because it closes off the escape vector before cgroup freeze is ever tested

probes.expectation: HTTP 401 — /stun is bearer-gated, same as /resume (a hardening landed after CRKC-P1-2 was authored)

probes.description: POST /stun with the correct bearer token, while the target is mid-fork-storm
freeze latency measured while pids.current was 182
probes.expectation: latency_ms < 50 — the freezer is a core kernel interface, not a per-task walk, so PID count should not matter

probes.description: a process that successfully unshared into a NEW pid namespace (SYS_ADMIN granted) is still inside the frozen cgroup
probes.expectation: freeze HTTP 200 (within 2 bounded attempts) AND cgroup-wide CPU usage_usec delta == 0 post-freeze — PID namespace escape does not defeat cgroup-v2 containment

probes.description: cgroup.events read directly from the kernel (not via the daemon)
two authenticated /resume calls issued back-to-back with no serialisation
probes.expectation: the daemon survives (still answers healthz afterwards); both calls return a definite HTTP status, neither hangs

probes.description: daemon healthz reachable immediately after the concurrent-resume probe
probes.expectation: alive — a race in /resume must not crash the containment daemon itself

probes.description: cgroup-wide CPU usage_usec delta after the concurrent-resume probe
probes.expectation: delta > 0 — execution actually resumed, the race did not leave the cgroup stuck frozen

probes.description: a container with memory.limit=32Mi allocating 512Mi via dd into /dev/shm
probes.expectation: container status reason is OOMKilled — the kernel's memory controller holds independent of the sentinel
